Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
Counsel for Applicant :- Lav Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajeev Singh,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the
record.

2.  The present application under Section 483 Cr.P.C. has been filed with the prayer to direct the court below to decide Criminal Case No.1508 of 2017 under Section 125 Cr.P.C. "Smt. Shyama Vs.
Abu Sahama" and Case No.1086 of 2017 under Section 12 D.V. Act, Police Station Madiyaon,
Lucknow and Case No.47371 of 2017 under Section 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D.P.
Act, Police Station Mahila Thana, District Lucknow, forthwith.

Smt. Shyama vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. on 16 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/61846498/
1 3.

entities.text: Smt. Shyama vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant filed aforesaid case, but his case has not been decided by the court below and only general dates are being given

, therefore,
indulgence of this Court is necessary to direct the court below for expeditious disposal of the aforesaid case.
4. Learned A.G.A. has no objection, in case, a direction for expeditious disposal of the case has been issued.

5. Considering the arguments of learned counsel for the parties and going through the records,
learned court below is directed to decide the case in question of the applicant, as expeditiously as possible, in accordance with law.
6. With the aforesaid direction, the present application under Section 483 Cr.P.C. is disposed of.

Order Date :- 16.8.2023 Gaurav/-
